reviews.review_text:
Sol
Vilnius, Lithuania78 contributions
0
One problem ruined all nice experience
Sep 2019 • Couples
My wife and I had dinner at this restaurant and we both decided the food was delicious. Somewhat surprised, the fried squid rings were brought straight to me with the main dish, and my wife had to wait at least 10 minutes for her dishes. Note for the future: Snacks should be brought as early as possible and main meals a little later, but for both guests at the same time. Very helpful staff. Sometimes even a little too helpful. The restaurant has some wine selection, which adds a lot of plus. So summing up, we could boost your business by giving 5 stars, even though it's a little hard to find where they're hiding, but ... When I saw and heard in the toilet, the only fan out of the toilet was brought to the kitchen (see photo). .. In Europe, such a restaurant would not even be authorized. It is crappy to even think about how all those bacteria are transported from the toilet room to the dishes by air, so I hope the restaurant can handle this problem and delight its guests with great dishes in the future. P.S. It is not 1 star because they do care about the plastic disposure.
Read more
Written September 27, 2019
Albin D
Dear Sightsee 794066,
Thank you very much for your review.
We are glad that you have enjoyed our food. Sorry that your starter arrived at the same time than your main. Our staff should have asked you if you wanted the squid as a starter, or if it was ok to bring all at once. Often our Vietnamese customers ask our staff to bring all the food at once. Sorry for this.
We will also remind our staff not to be too pushy.

Concerning the toilet, I m sorry to let you know that you have the wrong impression. The fan is not accessing to the kitchen but to semi outdoor space that is adjacent to the storage and receiving area of the kitchen, NOT directly to the kitchen. That area is as well well ventilated. Last and not least we have been through and have received our Hygiene license from the government. Never the less we appreciate your concern and we would be more than happy to show you that we do respect Hygiene regulations, and exceeding some of the local ones. 

Appreciate that you recognize as well our point to not minimize our impact on the environment

reviews.review_text:
Destination Review by Daniel
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam307 contributions
0
Worth for a change
Aug 2019 • Business
I decided to book because of its colourful pictures showing in the fan page as well as restaurant review page. The interior decoration is friendly and truely Mediterranean. I like it!

The most exiting was deep fried whitebait, totally different from same Vietnamese fish snack. The worst is Mussels, clams, chorizo & porto. Mussels n clam were small n dried, losing of taste, sauce was not that good. Paella was good, but the “spaghetti paella” was nothing special. Staff was friendly.

Food cost (not including wine) was more than 500,000 VND/ per head for lunch menu with some other dishes beside listed above, we order a la carte, not set lunch. Compared with same cost, we might have better Vietnamese seafood meal. 

Sorry for straight comment, but I may come back to try other dishes.
Read more
Written August 22, 2019
Albin D
Dear Daniel the walker,

Thank you for your review, we appreciate all of them, especially when it gives us opportunity to improve. Of course we prefer when we can talk directly with customers. 

Thank you to acknowledge that our decor and ambience is TRUELY Mediterranean.

Sorry that you found that the white bait was the most exiting. I have to be honest and let you know had little issue with our shell supplier, one main reason has been the weather that has been going and we did not have the consistency we would like. Problem we have to deal as we work with smaller suppliers. But this is not something that you should have to deal with.
Glad that you enjoyed as well the Paella and sorry that the Fideua was less interesting for you. (may be next time we can spice it up for you?)

Thank you again for your straight comments, let me assure you that we can straight them for an other time,
If you give us the chance. Please feel free to send us an email at info@freshcatch.vn or a quick messenger on our facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/freshcatchvietnam/ 
We will make sure that you will come out with a much better opinion and happier time. Limoncello on us to finish that time ;)

See you soon we hope,

The Fresh Catch team

My favorite Mediterranean restaurant in Saigon
Aug 2019 • Couples
I’ve traveled through Europe’s Mediterranean countries extensively. The decor is over the top, but in a good way. For a second, I could imagine myself on holiday in Barcelona or in Greece. 

The flavors here are authentic. My favorite dish would be the squid ink pasta. It was filled with seafood, from shrimp (perfectly grilled), octopus(tender yet with the right about of chew, clams, mussels, and scallops. 

The sardine toast was great. I’d have preferred a whole anchovy but I can’t complain about the flavors. 

I’d come back again, probably to try the Paella that everyone else is raving about. Its now my go to spot in Saigon when I’m craving Spanish/Greek flavors

So GOOD!!
Mar 2019 • Couples
Arriving at the venue we where welcomed with a friendly and big smile and guided upstairs to our table. First impression we got, was nice you noticed directly the attention for detail in the decor of the restaurant.

While walking upstairs, we heard a beautiful voice signing French classics, so nice!

Seated, and already enjoying a lot we where told that many dishes where not available as their supplier had not delivered this morning. But still choice enough we went with 5 different dishes, a combination of appetizers and main courses.

Each and every dish was just perfect.We enjoyed a lot, a truly "one of a kind restaurant" in Saigon.

Although the desserts where looking good, we did not eat dessert, as they did not had my favorite beer on the menu and the Belgo venue was just around the corner we decided to eat dessert in Belgo to fulfill my craving of my favorite craft beer.

Amazing place that do all right, from the atmosphere, the service and the food.
We will be back soon!

Written March 24, 2019
Albin D
Dear AnhBo,
Thank you very much for your review,
We are glad that you enjoyed our customer service.
We are sorry that you had to face a problem with some dishes being of the menu. As you have been explain we are working directly with small fishermen in the region of La Gi. So we are depending for part on what they can fish on the night before. So when the condition at sea are not good, we some time face limit of products. How ever now a days we have some new sources from Phu Quoc, so we can work on not having shortage of supply. 

We are glad that despite that situation you still really enjoyed the food. We would like to let you know that we do have now Belgo on the menu, so we hope we can welcome you back in our restaurant, so you can enjoy all of the best: Great food and Great Beer.

Hope to welcome you soon at Fresh Catch
